opening: Robert Glasgow of Prescott belongs to the documented sibling group with Daniel Glasgow of Kilrea and Thomas Glasgow of Lisnagaver. The original 1849 will and 1861 conveyance establish their identities and brotherhood. Alexander Glasgow-3904 is a supported uncertain father hypothesis through Thomas and Daniel’s existing family tradition.

position.answer: The Prescott–Kilrea–Lisnagaver brotherhood is established. Connect Robert and Samuel to Alexander-3904 as uncertain father through that group; the documents do not directly name a parent.
points: Original will and deed identity evidence already appears on the live sibling biographies.
